67

Position:
Lecturer in Computer Science (Fixed Pay)

Official Notification

Decision on Appeals – Lecturer in Computer Science (Fixed Pay)

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM)
has communicated the decisions on appeals submitted against the provisional quantification for the post of
Lecturer in Computer Science (Fixed Pay)
advertised under
Advertisement No. 67
.

Appeal Decision

Following scrutiny of the applications received in response to Advertisement No. 67 and consideration of the subsequent appeals against the provisional quantification, the decisions of the Appellate Committee have been communicated for information of all concerned.

Appeal Decision – Lecturer in Computer Science

View the decision through the official AWKUM Jobs Portal.

VIEW DECISION (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/appeal-decisions/67/lecturer-of-computer-science-on-fixed-pay)

Important Information

Important Instructions

The decision of the
Appellate Committee is final.

The
final merit list
shall be uploaded in due course of time.

All marks awarded are subject to
verification of credentials
. Any document found to be bogus, fake, or tampered with may lead to disqualification.

Eligible applicants will be invited for
demonstration and interview
before the Selection Committee. The schedule will be communicated in due course of time.

No TA/DA shall be admissible.

Errors and omissions are liable to rectification.

Further Updates

Applicants concerned are advised to regularly check the official AWKUM Jobs Portal for further updates regarding the final merit list and the schedule of demonstration and interviews.

Note:
Applicants should rely on official AWKUM communications and the AWKUM Jobs Portal for subsequent updates.
